description: This file defines the TagsViewHolder class used in a RecyclerView to display and manage UI interactions for tags within the application. It includes logic for binding tag data, handling user interactions such as clicks and long clicks, and updating UI components based on data changes.

classes.name: TagsViewHolder
classes.description: RecyclerView ViewHolder for displaying tag items with selection and interaction capabilities.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the tag name in the UI.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds TagData to the view, updating visibility and checked state based on the data.

methods.name: runPayloads
methods.description: Updates UI components based on a list of payloads, such as name changes.

methods.name: onSelectedStatusChanged
methods.description: Updates the visual selection state of the item.
